public_rationale: OpenAI's December 11, 2025 disclosure reports continuing factual errors in GPT-5.2 Thinking, with error-containing responses 30% less common than for GPT-5.1 Thinking [e3]. This supports continuing errors alongside improvement, but does not establish the state of all core LLM reliability problems [e3]. Stanford reports USD 109 billion in US private AI investment for 2024 [e4]. That annual US figure cannot verify or refute approximately USD 1 trillion in cumulative realized LLM investment through December 26, 2025 [e4]. The combined claim remains unresolved: the technical evidence provides partial support, while the monetary component remains unverified [e3] [e4].
limitations: The technical evidence comes from a model developer and does not cover all core LLM reliability problems.
The packet lacks a reproducible cumulative investment total through December 26, 2025.
The claim does not define the investment population, spending categories, accumulation start date, or acceptable reliability threshold.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: About a trillion dollars of investment has not fixed the core technical problems of LLMs.

statement.excerpt: And a trillion dollars or so of investment hasn’t remedied them.
statement.document_title: The AI bubble is all over now, baby blue

our_interpretation: The claim combines an approximately trillion-dollar investment total with continuing material reliability problems.
Remedied means that the core problems have been fixed sufficiently to provide dependable performance; it does not mean that no improvement occurred.
The ordinary monetary reading is cumulative investment already made by publication, rather than future commitments or annualized spending.
Dollars is read as US dollars. No companies, accumulation start date, investment categories, or accounting basis are supplied.
For the ongoing technical state, use December 2025 through the post date, the latest calendar month that could contain public evaluations. The cumulative financial period has no stated start.
criteria.support_condition: A clearly scoped total establishes approximately USD 1 trillion of realized relevant investment by publication, and contemporary evaluations establish that material factuality and reasoning failures persisted.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable evidence establishes that the relevant investment total was materially inconsistent with approximately USD 1 trillion, or that the core reliability problems had been remedied by publication.
